pages.text: You carry the smell of the Veil. It clings like smoke to a funeral coat.
A wound in the world, older than this village. The first keepers stitched it with names. We have forgotten half the thread.
The forest drinks root and memory. Its paths open only when the village's own dead are laid back to sleep.
A dungeon of stone that remembers, then a throne grown from one black thorn. That is all the veil permits me to say.
